We need a template that breaks C-H and forms C-Br. The search didn't include functional_groups_broken. Maybe we need to search with bonds_broken "C-H" and bonds_formed "C-Br". But we don't know format. Could try bonds_broken ["6-1"]? Not.

Simplify: maybe the correct template is the first one? But its mapped_rxn is huge and includes many other groups, not just simple bromination.
